containers.name: test
command:
set -eu
ROOT=<scratch>
TESTTMP=<scratch>
mkdir -p "$ROOT/logs" "$ROOT/target" "$TESTTMP"
test ! -e "$ROOT/source"
cat /chunks/0/chunk /chunks/1/chunk /chunks/2/chunk > "$ROOT/source.tar.gz"
echo 'ee3ae0196ae832de72d67e9c73218d071288f52578df5e07c5b8bce5652feaf1  '"$ROOT/source.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
mkdir "$ROOT/source"
tar -xzf "$ROOT/source.tar.gz" -C "$ROOT/source" 2> "$ROOT/logs/extract.log"
export PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:/usr/local/rustup/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export CARGO_HOME=<scratch> CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$ROOT/target" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 TMPDIR="$TESTTMP" SQLITE_TMPDIR="$TESTTMP"
cd "$ROOT/source"
rustc --version
status=0
run() { name=$1; shift; echo "COMMAND: $*" > "$ROOT/logs/$name.log"; if "$@" >> "$ROOT/logs/$name.log" 2>&1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; echo "SUITE=$name EXIT=$rc"; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then tail -n 120 "$ROOT/logs/$name.log"; status=$rc; else grep 'test result:' "$ROOT/logs/$name.log" || true; fi; }
run default-lib cargo test --locked --offline  --lib -- --test-threads=1
run default-integration cargo test --locked --offline  --test collections --test collection_pagewal --test schema_recovery --test pagewal --test pagewal_repair --test pagewal_recovery_identity --test pagewal_transaction_capacity --test recovery_faults -- --test-threads=1
run compact-lib cargo test --locked --offline --features compact-cells,sqlite-balance --lib -- --test-threads=1
run compact-integration cargo test --locked --offline --features compact-cells,sqlite-balance --test collections --test collection_pagewal --test schema_recovery --test pagewal --test pagewal_repair --test pagewal_recovery_identity --test pagewal_transaction_capacity --test recovery_faults -- --test-threads=1
run release-build cargo build --locked --offline --release --features compact-cells,sqlite-balance --bin v2_foundation_bench --bin v2_compat_fixture
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  sha256sum "$ROOT/target/release/v2_foundation_bench" "$ROOT/target/release/v2_compat_fixture" | tee "$ROOT/logs/binary-sha256.log"
  run smoke-off "$ROOT/target/release/v2_foundation_bench" "$ROOT/smoke-off" 10000 off
  run smoke-on "$ROOT/target/release/v2_foundation_bench" "$ROOT/smoke-on" 10000 on
fi
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  OLDROOT=<scratch>
  test ! -e "$ROOT/compat-copy"
  cp -a "$OLDROOT/fixtures" "$ROOT/compat-copy"
  run compat-new "$ROOT/target/release/v2_compat_fixture" verify-and-update "$ROOT/compat-copy" --confirm-copy
  run compat-old-raw "$OLDROOT/target/release/v2_compat_fixture" verify-raw "$ROOT/compat-copy"
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/legacy-replay"
  run compat-old-typed "$OLDROOT/target/release/v2_compat_fixture" legacy-replay "$ROOT/compat-copy/projected/checkpointed" "$ROOT/legacy-replay/checkpointed" --explicit-test-mode
  run compat-old-typed-wal "$OLDROOT/target/release/v2_compat_fixture" legacy-replay "$ROOT/compat-copy/projected/wal-pending" "$ROOT/legacy-replay/wal-pending" --explicit-test-mode
  (cd "$OLDROOT/fixtures" && sha256sum -c "$OLDROOT/logs/fixture-sha256.log") > "$ROOT/logs/original-fixture-preserved.log"
  echo ORIGINAL_REFERENCE_HASHES=UNCHANGED
fi
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  uname -a | tee "$ROOT/logs/benchmark-host.log"
  df -B1 <scratch> | tee -a "$ROOT/logs/benchmark-host.log"
  run bench-1m-off "$ROOT/target/release/v2_foundation_bench" "$ROOT/bench-1m-off" 1000000 off
  if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
    cat "$ROOT"/bench-1m-off/v2-foundation-1000000-*/REPORT.md
    run bench-1m-on "$ROOT/target/release/v2_foundation_bench" "$ROOT/bench-1m-on" 1000000 on
    if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then cat "$ROOT"/bench-1m-on/v2-foundation-1000000-*/REPORT.md; fi
  fi
fi
echo "FINAL_EXIT=$status" | tee "$ROOT/logs/summary.log"
exit "$status"
